title: Five Days to Write a Song

beats.title: the gang cools off after the song

beats.text: Excuse me, but how come I've got a lot of complaints about you guys running through the corridors
Well... Maria, we had to get an answer from Cream about why we're doing another musical so...
I can cancel the musical if you want or-
NO!
YES!
SPOILER ALERT!
That's the 2nd time he spoiled it
Wow! I'm surprised! I guess the show is on then!
By the way, Rouge, I liked that song so you better be singing that for the musical
Oh thank you, Maria!
but we're gonna need 3 more songs for the musical. So I'm counting on all of you to work as a team to create 3 more songs
You have 5 days, I'm counting on you *walks out the Stadium*
Now everyone, the next 3 songs are gonna be perfection! Since I'll be the lead singer
Hold up! You can't just be the lead singer for every song!
Yeah! What about Sonic and Amy?
Oh they're gonna be part of the song! Everyone is-
I think what they're trying to say is they want Sonic and Amy to perform a love song together
Exactly!
*blush*
Yes! It's perfect! For their 1st anniversary too!
and Cream could write the song! She's a good writer
I like this idea, I think it's cool
Yeah! It could be like the school's gift for their anniversary
( But how am I gonna tell her that we have to cancel the date for the game )
( I just don't wanna ruin her mood.. she looks so excited now.. what am I gonna do? )
( I love Amy very much... but the guys are right.. the game's important too.. )
Sonic, this is gonna be the best anniversary ever.
We're gonna celebrate your championship, we're gonna perform a love song together and we're gonna have the best date ever!
Uhm.. yeah! It's gonna be really.. great!
Yo everyone! *walking onto the stage* I'm gonna perform a song!
*kicks all doors in the Stadium open* This should be fun

beats.title: Shadow performs a dark song about painting the world black
Shadow keeps singing about black cars and flowers

beats.text: Ames.. I think we should get out of here
SHADOW!!
YUP TIME TO GO *picks up Amy and dashes out the stadium*
Wait- Guys?!
SHADOW!!! *fangirls crawling onto stage*
Oh.. sh**
